correctness.rationale: For every odd prime power the proof partitions all ordered difference fibers by matching coordinate valuation. Unit fibers correspond bijectively to quadratic roots and their two-parameter correlation to a smooth one-dimensional system, except for the unique singular root when parameters coincide modulo p. The singular branch is factored by a unit-determinant linear change into AB=constant and counted exactly in all valuation classes. Every boundary k=1, p=3 and lambda=mu is included; direct exhaustive enumerations pass across 1198 parameter pairs and 32 CRT tests. Finite checks only corroborate the complete mathematical proof.

value.rationale: The complete mixed energy is a canonical two-curve arithmetic additive invariant and equivalent all-frequency mixed Kloosterman fourth moment. The formula resolves every odd modulus and exhibits a nontrivial p-adic separation stratification: opposite square classes have no positive-valuation shared difference fibers, while matching reductions create successive singular layers. This exact comparative profile is not determined by the classical diagonal fourth moment or ordinary concentration bounds.
